met_criteria: acceptance_rules.py exports a single public function compare(llm_output: AppraisalOutput, deterministic_baseline: AppraisalOutput) -> ComparisonVerdict.

ComparisonVerdict is a Pydantic BaseModel with fields: overall (enum: STRUCTURAL_FAIL | SEMANTIC_PASS | SEMANTIC_DEGRADED), structural_failures (list of FieldFailure), semantic_deviations (list of FieldDeviation), field_results (dict mapping field name to FieldVerdict).
FieldFailure captures: field_name (str), reason (str). FieldDeviation captures: field_name (str), llm_value (str), baseline_value (str), severity (str).

Structural checks implemented: (1) tick_type agreement when both non-None; (2) absorption=none consistency (aftershock_days must be 0, growth must be empty); (3) unexpected zero-absorption mismatch recorded as structural failure.

Semantic checks implemented for all contract-bearing fields: absorption, valence (with sign-flip severity), arousal, aftershock_days (>1 overshoot), growth (missing/unexpected dimensions), relational (trust_shift agreement, closeness_delta sign agreement, None presence mismatch), guidance_resonance.
Advisory fields (narrative_summary, confidence, fallback_used) are explicitly excluded from all comparisons and documented in the module docstring.
When no structural failures and no semantic deviations, overall is SEMANTIC_PASS.
When no structural failures but one or more semantic deviations, overall is SEMANTIC_DEGRADED.
When one or more structural failures, overall is STRUCTURAL_FAIL regardless of semantic results.
The module is importable with no side effects and requires no environment variables.
non_blocking_suggestions: The module imports AbsorptionLevel from appraisal_settlement.py rather than from domain/appraisal_output.py. The constraint says not to import AppraisalSignal v1, and AbsorptionLevel is a settlement-layer enum.
